name: BRAND TEXT
description:
HEALTHLANDTM is a professional sauna manufacturer leader.Since 1993, HEALTHLANDTM has been committing to Research and Development of the infrared sauna. More than dozen year's experience made HEALTHLANDTM stand the test of time.



Square meters factory and most advanced production-lines, HEALTHLANDTM has annual producing capacity of 60,000 pieces. Usage of large numetric control woodworking machine ensures the processing accuracy of every piece of wood.The advanced Pre-Steamed-Wood drying art greatly extends the life of wood products and stability of moisture protection.



HEALTHLANDTM always firmly believes that "Quality Creates Brand" and is strictly carrying out the Quality Manage System to creat high quality sauna life.



Under Enterprise faith of creating a health sauna life,by virtue of strong R&D team,HEALTHLANDTM succeeds finishing lots of innovative designs and producing many kinds of infrared saunas through ODM for clients, which makes HEALTHLANDTM always lead the sauna industry trend.
